hard_constraints: Classify state from absolute frequency deviation.
For low frequency choose available lead with sufficient upward headroom and latency; maximize headroom then minimize latency.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
Optional rationale text is ignored by the deterministic evaluator.
